key_insight: A plug-and-play concept bottleneck framework can debug medical imaging models by intervening on human-interpretable concepts to separate truly causal signals from spurious ones.
clinical_relevance: This could help teams make clinical imaging AI more transparent, easier to audit with experts, and more reliable when refining models for real-world use.
method: Align a single-modality encoder to BioMedCLIP to build a concept bottleneck model.
Intervene at the concept level to test causality, identify spurious correlations, and generate counterfactual samples.
Use expert validation and targeted fine-tuning to refine model behavior while preserving performance.
evidence_signal: The framework was evaluated on a Mayo Clinic ultrasound dataset and the CheXpert 5x200 chest X-ray dataset, with results showing reliable model diagnosis and sometimes improved predictive performance after guided fine-tuning.
watch_item: Concept intervention depends on high-quality concept definitions and expert review, so the approach may be harder to implement if concepts are ambiguous or labeled data are limited.
paper_title: Beyond Explanation: Debugging Medical Imaging Models via Concept Intervention
